claims.summary: First Time Location
claims.note: Shipped as threat id 74 under Azure threats. The code differs from the spec in these details (the code wins): threat level is Low (spec: Informational); icon is fa-location-dot (spec: fa-globe); title is 'First Time Location by {user} detected' (spec: 'First Time Location detected by {user}'); the 30-day learning period is hardcoded, there is no 'Learning Period Days' setting; there are no custom exclusions (spec: Application and Source IP), the code instead enables the Location exclusion and keeps Perpetrator, Target, Client and the tag exclusions (spec: only User and Client/App); the detail page shows a world map instead of an attack path (TMR-1458); the evidence is one 'First Time Location' entry, not the spec's five items; only successful sign-ins count (TMR-1495). Spec says threat reproduction was unverified.
differences: Threat level is Low in the code; the spec says Informational
Icon is fa-location-dot in the code; the spec says fa-globe
Title reads "First Time Location by {user} detected"; the spec word order differs
Learning period is fixed at 30 days; there is no "Learning Period Days" setting
No custom exclusions: the Location exclusion is on, and Perpetrator, Target, Client and tag exclusions remain
The detail page shows a world map instead of the attack path
Evidence is one entry; the spec lists five items

claims.summary: Implement First Time Location
claims.note: Third sub-threat of the user/client/host summary job, id 74, listed under Azure, 30-day learning period, 24-hour rollup, exclusions as in the code.
